metadata.model: Gradient-boosted decision trees (scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingClassifier, logistic loss), area model
metadata.predicts: if at least one record is made in a 0.25 degree square in a month, how likely the species is among the species recorded
metadata.conditional_on: the square having at least one record that month; the source file lists only square-months with a record
metadata.what_it_is_not: not a count of animals and not a probability for a household; a record is one report by a person
metadata.layout: cells[i].p has 84 values: month 1 to 12, and within each month the species in the order of the species list
metadata.hyperparameters_note: same as the state model; not tuned on the test period

dataset.file: Iteration 3 Data for ML (grid cell, smoothed).csv

evaluation_summary.status: simple prediction; scores are reported beside simple baselines and carry no accuracy guarantee
evaluation_summary.limits: no single years in the file, so no rolling test years; the 2024 test period is one year while the training period is nine
